steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0106 and t0113 dependencies are completed.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: all relevant papers (Hay 2011, Druckmann 2007, Mohacsi 2024) already in corpus and analysed in t0106/t0112/t0113 research stages.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: no new external information needed; suggestion S-0113-03 is grounded entirely in existing corpus and prior task HV traces.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Survey t0113 fork base (nsga2_driver.py, hv_plateau_watchdog.py, constants*.py) and prior HV traces from t0106/t0112/t0113.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Write plan/plan.md with fork strategy, three constant patches, smoke-gate, Vast.ai provisioning, S-0113-03 offline replay.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision Vast.ai EPYC-class instance matching t0113's 64-core 7B13 profile via /setup-remote-machine.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Fork t0113 code, apply 3 constant patches (seed 7755, N_GEN=300, drop HVPlateauTermination), smoke-gate, launch NSGA-II on Vast.ai. Wait for operator stop.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy Vast.ai instance, finalise cost tracking, write remote_machines_used.json.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: out-of-the-box analysis is folded into the offline detector-replay step in results; no separate alternative-approach exploration warranted.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write 4-seed comparison results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, 5 charts, 3 CSVs. Implement S-0113-03 offline detector replay over all 4 seeds.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare 4-seed substrate-rate estimate and HV trajectory shape against Hay 2011, Druckmann 2007, Mohacsi 2024 baselines.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Write results/suggestions.json with follow-ups (5th seed for S-0112-01 batch completion, polar 8-dir recheck of t0114 joint-pass cells, etc.).

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, mark task completed.
